question.text: A PM forecasts interest rates will DECLINE over the next 6 months. To maximise portfolio price appreciation, she should:

explanation.text: The Logic: When rates fall, bond prices rise; longer duration = greater price sensitivity. Increasing duration amplifies gains from falling rates. The Trap: Decreasing duration protects against rising rates — opposite of the correct play. Floaters and T-bills are both low-duration defensive. Cross-Exam Context: Foundational FI; appears across IV, XIII, XXI-A. Manager's Pro-Tip: Check the PMS disclosure doc's duration bands before making the shift — some strategies hard-cap duration regardless of manager view.
